hooks.name: Auto Generate/Update Tests
hooks.description: When a TypeScript source file in the autoscript workspace is saved, create or update the matching vitest suite with coverage for new/changed behavior.

action.prompt:
A TypeScript source file in the autoscript pnpm workspace (apps/api, apps/rx-engine, packages/clinical-rules or packages/shared) was just created or changed. Locate or update the vitest suite that covers it:
- packages/clinical-rules/src/** -> packages/clinical-rules/src/__tests__/rules.test.ts
- apps/rx-engine/src/** -> apps/rx-engine/src/__tests__/<area>.test.ts (pipeline, extraction, reliability, examples, dataset, usDataset, eval); use the fake LLM in src/__tests__/fakeLlm.ts, never a real provider
- apps/api/src/** -> apps/api/test/api.test.ts (integration tests through buildServer + app.inject against the autoscript_test database)

Rules:
- Only act on modules with testable logic (rules, disposition, pipeline stages, retrieval, routes, services). Skip index.ts bootstraps, env loaders, pure type/schema re-exports and constants-only files.
- If a test already covers the module, extend it for new/changed exports and keep existing passing tests intact. Otherwise add a focused describe block (or a new *.test.ts next to the existing ones).
- Use vitest (describe/it/expect). Match the existing style: table-driven cases for rules, zod-parsed fixtures from @autoscript/shared, routes under the /api prefix.
- Cover the happy path plus edge/error cases (missing fields, unsupported files, 4xx responses, LLM failures and timeouts, VECTOR -> LEXICAL -> NONE retrieval fallback). Never assert that a prescription is "safe"; dispositions are MANUAL_REVIEW_NEEDED or NO_FLAGS_DETECTED.
- Do not weaken assertions just to make tests pass. After writing, run the package's suite from autoscript/: `pnpm --filter <package> test` (e.g. @autoscript/clinical-rules). The API suite needs the docker database (`pnpm db:up`). Fix failures in the test code.
- Keep changes scoped to test files; do not modify production source just to make tests pass unless the change revealed a genuine bug, in which case flag it.
